spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Imran Ferreira. I transferred money to someone who said they were from your fraud team, and now I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Imran. I can understand why you’re unhappy, and I’ll take ownership of this with you. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’m logging this as a complaint about the transfer and the contact you received. I’ll make sure the money is returned to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. They got me to send £2,450 on Monday, and then the number stopped working.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That sounds very upsetting. I’m sorry you’ve been put through this. I’ll record those details and make sure the complaint is handled properly.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want to know what’s actually going to happen now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the case to our fraud complaints team today. They’ll investigate the transfer and how the call was handled, and I’ll personally check it’s been assigned by tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I hear back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 15 business days. I’ll also call you by 5 pm tomorrow to confirm the team has picked it up and tell you how to contact me if you need an update.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’ve logged your complaint, I’m sending it to the fraud complaints team today, and I’ll call you by 5 pm tomorrow. You’ll get a full written response within 15 business days. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Imran. I’m sorry again this has happened, and I’ll follow it up as promised.
